elements.text:
Four commands change how wands look. Anyone can use them. They do not change how a wand works.

  /b/16wands/z - small wand icons.

  /b/32wands/z - big wand icons.

  /b/2dwands/z - wands are held flat, like a sword.

  /b/3dwands/z - wands are held as 3D models.

  The setting is your own. Changing it only changes what you see.
